gaps.reason: Public signup generates no control for a required Reference on the Account Entity.
gaps.consequence: Signup cannot supply this Reference, so its validation rejects new Accounts.

gaps.reason: The current Rails Compiler does not apply Reference defaults.
gaps.consequence: Reference storage, its belongs_to, and its consumers remain generated, but nothing applies the authored default, so a User created without team fails its "must exist" validation until application code applies it.
